messages:
Maya - CSM: Quick heads up — SunBridge QBR moved to Tue 3/30. I need a 3-slide cost section: 30d token variance, a 90d forecast to renewal, and a short mitigation playbook if they breach commit. Can @Olga and @Priya help pull numbers and root cause?
Jared - AE: Noted. Renewal is the week after the QBR; this will be a big signal for upsell/commit.
Priya - CSE: I pulled a quick trace — their nightly vectorize job spiked embeddings after the last model swap. Likely cause: the batch job re-run is using non-batched calls and a larger model.
Olga - Finance: I can run the forecast. Current committed tokens: 12,000,000/mo commit. Actual last 30d usage: 18,700,432 tokens. Forecasting burn at current run-rate = ~20.6M/month => ~+72% vs commit. Setting budget alert at 85% of commit now.
Maya - CSM: Oof. Can you drop the alert into the playbook doc and attach the forecast table? Also need suggested short-term actions we can recommend during QBR.
Priya - CSE: Short-term ops fixes: 1) throttle nightly job to run in smaller batches (reduce concurrency) 2) switch embed model from open-7b to open-3b-quant (quality tradeoff) 3) enable per-request prefix caching and dedupe identical inputs before embed calls. Example batch change: `for chunk in chunked(inputs, 256): client.embed(batch=chunk)`
Jared - AE: If we propose model switch, what's the expected cost delta? Need a simple number for the exec deck.
Olga - Finance: Quick calc: open-7b embeddings cost ~= $0.0006 per 1k tokens (internal rate), open-3b-quant ~= $0.00018 per 1k tokens. At 20M tokens: current = $12k/month, if switched = $3.6k/month => ~ $8.4k savings/month. Add one-time dev effort ~ 4-8h for the embed pipeline.
billing-bot: [automated] Alert: account sunbridge crossed 80% of commit (15,999,850 tokens) — threshold triggered at 1994501289
Maya - CSM: Perfect, @Olga — can you paste the 90d projection (CSV table) into the playbook? Priya, can you validate dedupe heuristics and estimated quality delta for open-3b-quant (just a sentence)?
Priya - CSE: Quick quality note: open-3b-quant loses ~2-3% embedding similarity on our eval set for search reranking. For intent clustering it's within noise. I'll run a 2-hour A/B over last week of logs and drop a one-paragraph summary.
Olga - Finance: Done — uploaded forecast CSV to the QBR folder: https://redwood.internal/qbr/sunbridge/costs.csv. Numbers include worst-case (no change), ops-fixed (throttle/dedupe), and model-swap scenarios.
Jared - AE: For the QBR slide, let's show: 1) variance chart (30d) 2) forecast to renewal (90d) 3) recommended immediate actions + expected $ savings. Keep it 1 slide.
Maya - CSM: I'll assemble the slide and tag you both for sign-off by Mon EOD. Quick action items: 
• Priya: run the 2-hr A/B and log quality sentence (due today EOD)
• Olga: finalize 90d forecast and upload CSV (done)
• Priya + Eng: provide a one-line estimated dev effort for switching model and batching (due Mon noon)
• Jared: flag renewal owner and include the cost slide in the renewal prep deck (due Mon EOD)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.
Priya - CSE: :thumbsup: I got this, will run A/B now.
Olga - Finance: :thumbsup: I left notes in the CSV about assumptions (daily ingestion, dedupe rate 30%).
Jared - AE: :thumbsup: looping in RenewalTeam lead at sunbridge.
Maya - CSM: Thanks all — will ping if we need a quick sync tomorrow.
